book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Sera i bone Aizak
Da AntapGod i bin mekem po Sera wiskain da AntapGod bin spik em go mekem.
Sera bin pamle ane em bin bone boi pikinini prom Eibram wen Eibram bin oulman. Disting i bin apen da seimkain wiskain wen God bin tok pas po Eibram.
Eibram bin kole boi pikinini blo em, Aizak.
Wen Aizak i bin eitdei oul, Eibram i bin kate poskin blo Aizak wiskain God i bin oda Eibram po mekem.
Eibram i bin 100 iya oul wen Aizak i bin bon.
Sera i bin spik, ‘God i bin meke mi nadakain api, ane meke mi lap. Ebriwan uda go lisen dis tok, dempla gobi api bikoz ai api.’
Ane Sera i bin spik gen, ‘Nobodi bin tingk ai go gad pikinini prom Eibram. Wa! Ai bin bone boi pikinini prom Eibram ane em i oulman.’
Eibram i seswei Eiga ane Ismaiel
Aizak bin kam boi nau ane em i nomo dringke susu, so Eibram bin meke big kaikai lo seimtaim.
Melen da big kaikai, Sera i bin luk da boi blo Eiga, oman sebant blo em. Eiga em i Iziptoman. Da boi blo Eiga bin moke Aizak.
Sera bin tok strong po Eibram, ‘Seswei da sebant oman ane boi blo em go ausaid, bikoz ai no wande demtu go kese eni gudsamting blo yu. Mata boi blo yu Aizak, go kese ebri gudsamting blo yu.’
Eibram bin prapa atso bikoz Ismaiel i bin pikinini blo em tu.
Bat God i bin spik po Eibram, ‘Yu no atso po da boi pikinini ane sebant oman blo yu prom wanem Sera bin spik po yu. Mata mekem bikoz yu go gad pamlelain tru Aizak.
Bat ai go meke boi blo Eiga kam bigate blo wan bigmob pipol uda stap wea dempla oun kantri, bikoz em boi blo yu.’

Wa, neks moning, Eibram i bin gedap prapa eli, ane em bin meke ol kaikai redi ane teke wan skinbaig prapa pulap wea wata ane em bin gibem po Eiga. Em bin pute dem samting lo solda blo Eiga ane bin spik po demtu po go ane libe aus blo Eibram biain. So Eiga ane boi blo em bin lego go ane demtu bin wagbaut eniwea lo da dezet eria blo Bisiba.
Wen wata insaid da skinbaig bin pinis, Eiga i bin libe boi blo em andanit wea wan smoltri po seid.

Den Eiga bin go ane sidaun stret kros prom em, no prapa longwei. I bin baut 100 mita ane em tok po emselp, ‘Yagar! Ai no wande witnis dis pikinini po ded.’ Ane wen em bin sidaun kros prom da pikinini em bin stat po krai.
Ane God bin lisen krai blo da pikinini, ane da einzel blo God i bin singaut po Eiga prom antap, ane em spik, ‘Eiga! Aukam yu wori? No prait. God i bin lisen da krai blo da boi blo yu.
Stanap! Kese an blo da boi pikinini klostu. Ai go meke em bigate blo wan prapa bigmob pipol uda stap wea dempla oun kantri.’
Den God i bin meke Eiga po paine wan wel wea i gad wata insaid. Eiga bin go ane em bin pilemap da skinbaig wea wata ane em bin go gibe pikinini wata po dringk.
God i bin lugaut da pikinini antil em bin bigman. Em bin stap wea da dezet eria blo Paran ane em bin kam prapa gud po anting lo bounaro.
Dat taim wen Ismaiel i bin stap lo da dezet eria blo Paran, mama blo em i bin mekem stret po wan Iziptoman po kam oman blo Ismaiel.
Eibram i meke strong griment wea king blo Gera
Lo dat seimtaim nau King Abimalek ane Paikol, uda da bos blo ol amiman blo Abimalek, bin kam yan lo Eibram. King Abimalek i bin spik po Eibram, ‘Ai sabe God i elpe yu lo ebrisamting yu mekem.

Wa. Yu mas meke strongpromis prant wea God. Yu nogo meke ol nugud samting gense mi ane ol pikinini blo mi ane gense ol pamlelain blo mi. Ai bin meke gudpasin po yu, so yu mas meke gudpasin po mi ane po ol pipol blo dis kantri blo mi, bikoz yu stap ya wase ausaidman.’
Den Eibram i bin ansa, ‘Wa! Prant wea God ai go mekem wanem yu bin wande mi po mekem.’
Den Eibram bin komplein po Abimalek diskain, em no bin laik wiskain sam dem sebant blo Abimalek bin sanewei sam sebant blo em prom wan wel.
Abimalek bin ansa po Eibram, ‘Ai no sabe uda bin meke disting. Watpo yu no bin spik mi disting? Diswan pastaim ai lisen dis tok.’
Den Eibram bin teke ol sip, ane ol buluk ane em bin gibem po Abimalek ane demtu bin meke kontrak.
Den apta, Eibram bin teke nada seben yang omansip ane putem go wansaid.
Ane Abimalek i bin spik po Eibram, ‘Aukam yu bin pute dem seben yang omansip go wansaid?’
Eibram ansa gobaigen po Abimalek, ‘Yu mas teke dem seben yang omansip prom mi, solong wen yu teke dem sip i go soe ebribodi, ai bin digine dat wel.’
Tru gar, da ples i bin kolem Bisiba. Bisiba i min ‘wel blo promis’, bikoz i bin de demtu bin gri po mekem wanem demtu bin spik demtu go mekem.
Apta nau wen Eibram ane King Abimalek bin pinis meke strongpromis de lo Bisiba, Abimalek ane Paikol da bos blo dem amiman blo King Abimalek, i bin gobaigen wea da ples blo dem pipol blo Pilistia.
Den apta nau Eibram bin plante wan tamarisktri de lo Bisiba ane Eibram i bin wosip da AntapGod, da longlaip God.
Eibram i bin stap wase ausaidman po longtaim lo da ples blo dem pipol blo Pilistia.
